integrity: Integer-polynomial identities plus a separate characteristic-eleven analysis prove the classification. Independent external audit or validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The classification treats smooth quartics of the specified exact cyclic-six family over algebraically closed fields of characteristic at least five. It counts geometric hyperflexes, not all bitangents or Weierstrass points. The geometric isomorphism counts use a published normal-form criterion. Published characteristic-zero classifications are not claimed as new. Unindexed equivalent computations are a residual priority risk.
title: Hyperflex jumps in characteristic at least five on the cyclic-six plane-quartic locus
